title: Young and beautiful
objectives: describe people using to be and basic adjectives
ask simple questions about age and appearance

teacherNotes.title: Stage aim
teacherNotes.content: Greet student and introduce lesson objectives for Young and beautiful.
Welcome to today's lesson: Young and beautiful! Today we will practice how to describe people using to be and basic adjectives.

elements.content: Lesson Objectives for Young and beautiful:
describe people using to be and basic adjectives; ask simple questions about age and appearance

teacherNotes.title: Stage aim
teacherNotes.content: Introduce target vocabulary and key language structures using concept check questions.

elements.content: Review key terms and target language below:
Key terms: married, single, big, small, beautiful, young

teacherNotes.title: Stage aim
teacherNotes.content: Check understanding through controlled choice exercise.

teacherNotes.title: Stage aim
teacherNotes.content: Develop reading comprehension and listening skills.

teacherNotes.title: Listening Tapescript
teacherNotes.content: Hi, I am Anna. I am single and twenty years old. My friend Marco is married and very happy.

elements.content: Read the short passage below (recycling introduced vocabulary):
She is young and beautiful. He is single and happy. They are a big and nice team.
Listening Task: Listen to your teacher / audio prompt and answer the comprehension question.

teacherNotes.title: Stage aim
teacherNotes.content: Provide communicative speaking practice and personalized interaction.

elements.content: Describe two famous people or friends using adjectives (young, beautiful, single, married).

teacherNotes.title: Stage aim
teacherNotes.content: Review key corrections and confirm homework task.
Great work today! Remember to review target words in your mobile app before our next class.

elements.content: Today you practiced: describe people using to be and basic adjectives, ask simple questions about age and appearance.
